args.name: page
args.doc: home: the landing page with the destinations; plan: the trip builder; checkout: review and pay.

moves.say: {go: plan} at the start of the sentence that takes them to the trip builder; {go: home} for the destinations.
moves.doc: Go to one of the site's pages, ringing the link first.

args.name: step
args.doc: A step of the trip builder.

moves.say: {step: flights} as you start talking about that step of the trip builder: brief, flights, hotels, days or package.
moves.doc: Open a step of the trip builder and ring its tab. Refused while the brief is missing what that step needs.

args.name: target
args.doc: Something on screen by the name it shows: flight 2, Sayan Ridge Villas, day 3, total, price breakdown.

moves.say: {show: day 3} right before the sentence about it, to ring it on screen; {show: flight 1}, {show: total}.
moves.doc: Scroll to a named thing on the page and ring it. Changes nothing.

args.name: from_city
args.doc: Airport code of the city they fly from: DEL, BOM, BLR, MAA, CCU, HYD, AMD, PNQ.

args.name: destination
args.doc: Destination id: kerala, goa, rajasthan, bali, dubai, thailand, singapore, maldives, switzerland.

args.name: kids
args.doc: Each child's age, 0 to 11, as digits ("6"). Strings, because a move's array arguments travel as strings.

args.name: budget
args.doc: Total budget in rupees for everyone, 0 for none.

moves.doc: Fill the trip brief's fields that are given, ringing each one; the page opens the brief step if it is not on it.
Open the flights step with the options for the brief, sorted.

args.name: flight_id
args.doc: A flight option id from the inventory, DEL-bali-2.

moves.doc: Ring a flight option and select it.

args.name: want
args.doc: A tag to filter by: beach, pool, budget, luxury, family, honeymoon, relaxed, adventure, culture.

moves.doc: Open the hotels step on one city's tab, optionally filtered by a tag.
Ring a hotel's room in a city and select it, replacing that city's hotel.

args.name: split
args.doc: Nights in each city of the destination, in route order, as digits ("2", "4"), summing to the trip's nights. Strings, because a move's array arguments travel as strings.

moves.doc: Set how the nights are split across the destination's cities; activities on days that move city are dropped.

args.name: day
args.doc: Day of the holiday, 1 = arrival day.

moves.doc: Ring a day and add an activity to it.
Ring an activity on a day and take it off.

args.name: hotels
args.doc: One per city with nights, as city:hotel_id:room_id.

moves.doc: Lay a whole package on the page: the flight, a hotel per city, the activities, then open the package step with the priced day-by-day plan.

slices.doc: the last change made to the trip on screen, by ids, as the page reports it

events.doc: One field of the brief changed.

events.ask: congratulate them in one short line and read the booking reference
